Changes: independent Blessing of Pandora marker and shader namespace; fixed rose-pink palette;
only Love Orb item names; mixed text runs preserve ordinary chat text; reduced halo samples;
render-time animation, no item NBT updates, reflection or dependency on The Long Travail.

The adapted Java source is included under META-INF/third-party/tlt-love-name/source/.
The adapted shader source is in assets/blessingofpandora/shaders/core/love_name.*.
Those files are distributed under MPL-2.0. Other project files retain their own licenses.
